texts.name: Haugir
texts.biography: Haugir's mother sailed the seas, one day returning from a voyage to distant lands with a child in her womb. Her son's greatest gripe was his eyes lacking a true frost giant's icy tinge, so he vowed to acquire the largest, purest crystals and carve himself a new pair out of them. Thus far, Haugir has found one that fits the purpose, but he still seeks its perfect match.

specialty.name: Navigation
specialty.description: In the presence of Navigation skill hero receives a bonus of 5% extra movement points at sea per level.
